findings.description: A bare `charset` parameter now causes encoding detection to raise `AttributeError`. The parser stores `True`, but `get_encoding_from_headers` expects the charset value to be a string.
findings.rationale: For a response with `Content-Type: text/plain; charset`, the changed parser returns `{"charset": true}`. `get_encoding_from_headers` then calls `.strip()` on that boolean, causing response processing to fail instead of using the previous default encoding.
